Six days ago, Apple released iOS 27.2 developer beta 1, skipping iOS 27.1 beta. With yesterday's release of developer beta 2, Apple has now rolled out the first iOS 27.2 public beta version, which includes the new iPhone Health app. Apple has also enabled the ability to schedule and purchase lab tests through Quest Diagnostics from the new Health app.

iOS 27.2 beta includes a brand-new Health app and more

iOS 27.2 will be the next version after iOS 27, which officially launched on September 14. iOS 27.1 is only available for the iPhone Duo.

Apple has detailed how the iOS 27.1 SDK lets developers take full advantage of the iPhone Duo display. You can see here how apps will appear on the iPhone Duo depending on which iOS version they target.

Apple released Xcode 27.1 beta on Friday, adding iPhone Duo simulator support as well as app development support for this new foldable iPhone.

The first iOS 27.2 developer beta includes the following changes:

  • The redesigned Apple Health app, first announced at the iPhone 18 Pro launch event, is now available on this beta.
  • Dual-camera shooting mode comes to group FaceTime.
  • Siri AI language support now adds French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Apple TV app profile feature comes to iPhone.
  • Apple Podcasts' "Up Next" has been renamed to "Latest Episode." The "Continue Playing" section is now placed directly below "Latest Episode." Podcast episode lists also now use background colors that match the artwork.
  • Apple Music now uses fewer icon colors within the app to mark labels.

iOS 27.2 is expected to officially release in October. For iPhone users who want to try the new Apple Health app early, there are now two paths to choose from: developer beta and public beta.
